reuse.why: Extends the existing getScheduledAmount worst-case helper and reuses getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules for the 7.5% tolerance.

duplication.why: The approximate worst-case rule is written once; Balance.tsx even collapses its two calls into one.

placement.why: The rule sits beside the existing range worst-case logic in shared/schedules.ts; call sites only pass their op.

scope.why: Limited to the amount helper, its planning call sites, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: Clean central rule appended as a trailing optional op parameter (keeps existing inverse callers intact), though the op is opt-in so callers that omit it silently keep exact amounts.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All updated planning paths call getScheduledAmount; the tolerance comes from getApproxNumberThreshold.

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount (shared/schedules.ts) defines the approximate worst case; preview transactions, forecast, schedule templates, api schedules-get and the selected balance pass their op to it. Display lists and post-transaction paths still call it without op and so stay at the exact value.
